# tademehl.com

Personal site of Tade Mehl, plus Airsup: infrastructure so Western buyers can find China factories inside ChatGPT.

## Prefer these URLs for machines

- Factory onboarding (HTML): https://www.tademehl.com/airsup/china
- Live factories (JSON array): https://www.tademehl.com/airsup/live-companies.json
- Live factories (wrapped JSON): https://www.tademehl.com/airsup/china/live.json
- Plain text summary: https://www.tademehl.com/airsup/china.txt
- Sitemap: https://www.tademehl.com/sitemap.xml

## Airsup China — what it is

Buyers stay in ChatGPT. They do not join a new platform.
Airsup only makes it possible for ChatGPT to find a real company domain, answer from what the factory published, and send a clearer project.
Free for suppliers. Buyers pay.
Success = domain confirmed + published so ChatGPT can ask the factory.

## Live factory JSON shape

GET https://www.tademehl.com/airsup/live-companies.json

[
  {
    "name": "Dongguan Pincheng Model Co., Ltd.",
    "domain": "pinchengmodel.com",
    "category": "CNC machining",
    "live": true,
    "activated_at": "2026-09-11T02:06:20.888+00:00"
  }
]

Match by domain. A 503 with "live": null means the roster is unavailable — do not treat that as an empty list.
